model.name: A WRITE must not mutate fields it was not asked to change (migration, handler, re-persist) — before/after differential asserts ONLY declared targets differ, fail-closed
model.description: STANDING LAW: A WRITE (migration, dedup, handler, re-persist — ANY code that persists) MUST NOT MUTATE FIELDS IT WAS NOT ASKED TO CHANGE. CORRECTED live instance (2026-09-06, architect-measured — the earlier attribution to migrate-one-store.ts was WRONG): migrate-one-store.ts is EXONERATED (byte-identical copy, writeFileSync + skip-if-exists, NEVER overwrites — cannot blank a name or reset a timestamp). The REAL chain: Room.persistMembers (Room.ts:401) writes name:m.name, so a member whose PROFILE was DELETED persists with an EMPTY name; plus joinedAt:Date.now() churn + createdAt reconstruction; and the LOAD path additionally DROPS profile-less members. TRIGGER: the PO test-room/profile cleanup ORDER deleted profiles and caused a bystander room to re-persist. The room re-persist was NOT a migration at all, yet mutated fields nobody asked it to -> the law covers ANY WRITE. One step MORE GENERAL than member-name-must-survive; the cure is the PROVEN differential (assert ONLY the intended change), now a precondition on every write.

discoverySource.correctionProvenance: architect MEASURED the writer after req wrote the wrong actor (migrate-one-store). Measure-not-relay on a DEFECTs CAUSE: a bug naming the wrong component sends the next engineer to fix an already-correct script while the real hazard sits untouched = misattribution rot on a cause, worse than a commit misattribution (survives as received wisdom).

discoverySource.blastRadius: 7 more modified room units; whether any member was DROPPED ENTIRELY (load-path drop of profile-less members) is the OPEN question, being measured.

model.queuePriority: TIER-A guard — by-construction (a SPEC not a build; makes the whole out-of-scope-mutation class impossible for the NEXT migration).
model.differentialDisciplineProven: The before/after differential (assert ONLY the intended change) is PROVEN: it caught the project:model extra node (PAIR-2 byte-identity gate), and it is PROTECTING the 5-row repair right now (Bug 88df8e4e exactly-5 + R40.106 migration-transparent-differential). R40.107 generalizes it to EVERY migration/dedup.
model.crossRefNote: Same hazard class as Bug 206a28bc (a name wrongly SET/LOST at a WRITE path — there the WebItem mint, here the migration). The live instance rides the R40.81 one-store migration. Generalizes the differential in R40.106 (containment repoint) + R40.81 apply-time ACs to the UNIVERSAL rule: no migration mutates out-of-scope fields.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A WRITE (migration/dedup/handler/re-persist) asserts a BEFORE/AFTER DIFFERENTIAL where ONLY its DECLARED target fields differ. Any field NOT in the declared scope that changes => RED.

gateRef.assertion: the migration declares its target fields; before/after: only declared fields differ, all others byte-identical; any out-of-scope field change => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a migration that also touches an undeclared field -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: IDENTITY fields (member name, uuid) and PROVENANCE timestamps (joinedAt, createdAt) are BYTE-IDENTICAL through the migration UNLESS explicitly targeted. A member name blanked, a uuid changed, or joinedAt/createdAt rewritten without explicit targeting => RED (the exact live instance: Marcel Donges -> '' + timestamps rewritten on room 3231db71).

gateRef.assertion: member name / uuid / joinedAt / createdAt survive byte-identical unless declared-target; a silent blank/rewrite => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a relocate-migration that blanks a member name or rewrites joinedAt/createdAt -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: On an out-of-scope change DETECTED, the run FAILS CLOSED — it REFUSES TO WRITE the mutation, rather than writing it and reporting after. Fail-safe is not enough; it must not persist the out-of-scope change AT ALL.

gateRef.assertion: an out-of-scope diff halts the run BEFORE writing (nothing persisted); a run that writes the out-of-scope change then flags it => RED

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed an out-of-scope change: the run must abort pre-write, not write-then-flag -> RED

acceptanceCriteria.text: The WRITE tool/handler REFUSES TO RUN AT ALL until the differential assertion EXISTS — a write with no scope-differential cannot execute (the assertion is a precondition, not an optional check).

gateRef.assertion: every migration/dedup entrypoint has a scope-differential assertion wired as a run precondition; a migration lacking it => RED (cannot run)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a migration entrypoint with no scope-differential -> RED (refuses to run)

acceptanceCriteria.text: A re-persist PRESERVES every stored field the write does not model — an ARBITRARY (unmodeled) stored field SURVIVES a re-persist, not just model.protected. This is the CONSTRUCTIVE twin of the don't-mutate law: Room.persist() rebuilds the unit by enumerating owned fields and silently DROPS any stored key it doesn't model (Tron's ACTIVE rooms LOST their keep-marks on re-persist). FIX at the ONE chokepoint: carry forward every stored key the write does not set. ★ DISCRIMINATION: fixes the CLASS, not one field — 'enumerate + add protected' is a FALSE fix that leaves the class lossy; the arbitrary-field canary must catch it.

gateRef.assertion: an ARBITRARY stored field survives a re-persist; a re-persist that drops an unmodeled stored field => RED; a fix that preserves only 'protected' but drops an arbitrary field => RED (class not field)

acceptanceCriteria.stubMustFail: seed a re-persist that drops an arbitrary unmodeled stored field (or a fix that only carries 'protected') -> RED

model.relatedHazardRecommended: ★ REAL HAZARD the architect surfaced (RECOMMENDED to PO, not minted — governance): IDENTITY COUPLED TO PROFILE EXISTENCE. A member name derives from its profile via m.name, so deleting the profile blanks the name, and the load path DROPS profile-less members. That is a distinct defect (member identity/name must SURVIVE profile deletion; a profile-less member must not lose its name or be dropped). R40.107 is the LAW (no out-of-scope write); the identity-coupling is the specific INSTANCE defect. Recommend a bug on PO go; blast-radius measurement pending.
